music.identity: Listener of minimalism, contemporary classical, and neoclassical music with deep engagement in the repetitive pattern tradition. Philip Glass is the gravitational center. The profile spans from pure American minimalism (Reich, Adams, Glass) through European neoclassical (Mertens, Nyman, Pärt) to modern post-minimalism (Richter, Jóhannsson, Arnalds) and ambient electronic crossovers.
